'''TK-290'''<ref name="FACPOV" /> was a [[human]]<ref name="ECUC" /> [[Gender|male]] [[scout trooper]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as part of [[Ghost Lancers]] [[company]]. During his time on the [[forest]] [[moon]] [[Endor]], TK-290 and his companion [[Raab Krao]] spotted [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker]], riding commandeered [[74-Z speeder bike]]s, pursuing one of their fellow troopers. Krao noticed that their comms were jammed, and TK-290 noted that if the other scout could get one hundred [[meter]]s away, they could send a transmission. Vowing to buy their comrade breathing room, the two gave chase in their own speeders. However, when Skywalker slammed on the brakes and got behind them, he fired on TK-290 and damaged his speeder, causing him to crash into a [[tree]] and [[Death|die]].<ref name="FACPOV" />
